changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 364 يلتزم البائع بتسليم الشيء المبيع للمشتري في الحالة التي كان عليها وقت البيع
changes.reason: [civil-code 364 ¶1] puts on the seller the duty to deliver the thing in the state it was in at the sale, as the catalogue says.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 367 كيف يتم التسليم: وضع المبيع تحت تصرف المشتري
changes.reason: [civil-code 367 ¶1] defines delivery as putting the thing at the buyer's disposal once he is told; [civil-code 367 ¶2] adds delivery by mere agreement, kept as its own statement.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 164 يجبر المدين بعد إعذاره على التنفيذ العيني متى كان ممكنا
changes.reason: [civil-code 164 ¶1] compels performance in kind after notice under articles 180 and 181; the formal-notice module carries it, so it is imported, not restated.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 174 غرامة إجبارية (تهديدية) لإجبار المدين على التنفيذ
changes.reason: [civil-code 174 ¶1] allows the coercive penalty only where performance is impossible or unsuitable unless the debtor does it himself, and sets no daily unit; [civil-code 174 ¶2] lets the judge raise it, and [civil-code 175 ¶1] fixes the final compensation. The role becomes the condition plus the accessory request.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 119 بديلا عن التسليم: الفسخ بعد الإعذار مع التعويض
changes.reason: [civil-code 119 ¶1] allows performance or rescission after notice, with damages where due, and [civil-code 119 ¶2] lets the judge grant time or refuse a minor rescission; both are carried by the formal-notice module and imported.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 122 بعد الفسخ يعاد المتعاقدان إلى ما كانا عليه (استرجاع الثمن)
changes.reason: [civil-code 122 ¶1] restores the parties to their prior position after rescission, which carries the return of the price, and allows compensation when that is impossible.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 179 لا يستحق التعويض إلا بعد إعذار المدين
changes.reason: [civil-code 179 ¶1] makes compensation due only after notice unless a text provides otherwise; the formal-notice module carries it, so it is imported.

changes.catalogueSays: commercial-code 30 يثبت العقد التجاري بالفاتورة المقبولة والرسائل والدفاتر وغيرها
changes.reason: [commercial-code 30 ¶1] to [commercial-code 30 ¶7] list official and private instruments, the accepted invoice, letters, books, and witnesses or other means the court accepts; the catalogue's summary holds, with its ledger not clean (checklist k32).

changes.catalogueSays: إلزام المدعى عليه بتسليم (...) تحت غرامة تهديدية قدرها (...) دج عن كل يوم تأخير
changes.reason: Delivery rests on [civil-code 364 ¶1]; the penalty is split into its own accessory request under [civil-code 174 ¶1], whose text sets no daily unit, so the unit is left to the lawyer.

changes.catalogueSays: احتياطيا: فسخ عقد البيع وإلزام المدعى عليه بإرجاع الثمن المقدر بـ (...) دج
changes.reason: Rescission after notice rests on [civil-code 119 ¶1] (imported) and the return of the price on [civil-code 122 ¶1]; written as two request lines, one per request kind.

changes.catalogueSays: تحميل المدعى عليه المصاريف القضائية
changes.reason: [cpca 419 ¶1] puts the costs on the losing party unless the judge decides otherwise with reasons.

changes.catalogueSays: الفاتورة أو عقد البيع
changes.reason: Proof of the sale by [commercial-code 30 ¶4] (accepted invoice) and [commercial-code 30 ¶3] (private instrument), and in a civil sale by writing under [civil-code 333 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: وصل دفع الثمن
changes.reason: Payment matters because the price is due at delivery [civil-code 388 ¶1] and the seller may keep the thing until paid [civil-code 390 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: محضر الإعذار
changes.reason: [civil-code 180 ¶1] allows a warning, an act standing in its place, post, or an agreed default at the term, so the module's documents (the notice, its service record or receipt, the clause, or the debtor's written refusal) replace the single bailiff record.

changes.catalogueSays: تاريخ البيع ومحله وثمنه
changes.reason: The sale and its price are what [civil-code 351 ¶1] defines; element e1 states them, with the proof rules of [commercial-code 30 ¶1] and [civil-code 333 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: دفع الثمن
changes.reason: Element e2: the price is due at delivery [civil-code 388 ¶1] and an unpaid due price lets the seller withhold [civil-code 390 ¶1] [civil-code 123 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: أجل التسليم المتفق عليه
changes.reason: Element e3; failing an agreed date, delivery is taken without delay where the thing was [civil-code 394 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: الإعذار وتاريخه
changes.reason: Notice before performance, rescission and damages under [civil-code 164 ¶1], [civil-code 119 ¶1] and [civil-code 179 ¶1], imported with its means and date; after notice the risks pass to the seller [civil-code 168 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: عدم التسليم إلى اليوم
changes.reason: Element e4, measured against what delivery is [civil-code 367 ¶1] and [civil-code 368 ¶1]; the seller proves his release [civil-code 323 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: لا يستحق التعويض إلا بعد إعذار المدين
changes.reason: [civil-code 179 ¶1], carried by the formal-notice module's prior step, which warns and never blocks because the paragraph states no inadmissibility.
One element per event of the brief, with burden and proof: the plaintiff proves the sale and payment, the seller proves delivery under [civil-code 323 ¶1].
No special period in the sale chapter governs the buyer's claim; the general limitation of [civil-code 308 ¶1] from the due date is imported from the periods module and only warns.
Notice before rescission [civil-code 119 ¶1] and before performance in kind [civil-code 164 ¶1], imported; both warn, as neither paragraph makes the claim inadmissible.

Territory: the defendant's domicile [cpca 37 ¶1] [cpca 38 ¶1], the commercial options [cpca 39 ¶5], supplies [cpca 39 ¶4], clauses between traders [cpca 45 ¶1] and the timing of the plea [cpca 47 ¶1].

Own section rule: commercial section for a commercial dispute [cpca 531 ¶1], listing by the nature of the dispute [cpca 32 ¶4], civil section in a court without sections [cpca 32 ¶5], real-estate section for real property; interpretive while the definition of commercial acts is not in the store.
Partial, short or defective delivery is not non-delivery: [civil-code 365 ¶1] [civil-code 366 ¶1] and [civil-code 379 ¶1] [civil-code 383 ¶1], each with a one-year period from delivery.
Loss before delivery without the seller's fault ends the sale by law and the price is recovered [civil-code 369 ¶1]; damage before delivery gives rescission or a reduction [civil-code 370 ¶1].
The seller's own claim and the rescission of a movable sale for unpaid price [civil-code 392 ¶1], imported as formal-notice b16.
Sale of real property or a business requires an official deed on pain of nullity [civil-code 324 مكرر 1 ¶1].
A sale subject to tasting is formed only on acceptance [civil-code 354 ¶1].
An unpaid price balance due lets the seller keep the thing: [civil-code 388 ¶1] [civil-code 390 ¶1] [civil-code 123 ¶1].

The notice rules, means [civil-code 180 ¶1], exemptions [civil-code 181 ¶2] to [civil-code 181 ¶5], rescission clause [civil-code 120 ¶1] and impossibility [civil-code 121 ¶1], from the formal-notice module.
General limitation [civil-code 308 ¶1] from the due date [civil-code 315 ¶1], counted under [civil-code 314 ¶1], with the proof of interruption.

Exits to the administrative court [cpca 800 ¶2], to the specialised commercial court [cpca 536 مكرر ¶1] with its conciliation, the criminal case on the same facts [civil-code 339 ¶1], and arbitration [cpca 1045 ¶1], from the ordinary-court-exits module.
The statements on the sections [cpca 32 ¶3] [cpca 32 ¶4] [cpca 32 ¶5] [cpca 531 ¶1] [cpca 511 ¶1] that the claim's own section rule cites.
Damages as an accessory request: assessment by [civil-code 182 ¶1], limited to foreseeable harm by [civil-code 182 ¶2], due after notice (imported p1).
For a thing identified by kind, purchase at the seller's expense with the judge's leave or its value [civil-code 166 ¶2], an alternative to the penalty.
Provisional execution on request [cpca 323 ¶2] or in urgency [cpca 323 ¶3].

Context statements for the elements: the sale [civil-code 351 ¶1], delivery of goods to be sent [civil-code 368 ¶1], place and time of taking delivery [civil-code 394 ¶1], risk after notice [civil-code 168 ¶1], the seller's duty to transfer [civil-code 361 ¶1].
Burden and means of proof: [civil-code 323 ¶1] and, for a civil sale, [civil-code 333 ¶1].
